name: govdoc-explainer
description: Pre-process government documents into searchable, LLM-summarized static HTML

scripts.build: npm run build:python && npm run build:search
scripts.stop: pkill -TERM -f '[g]ovdoc_explainer' && echo 'Stop signal sent — finishing current document, then exits. Re-run build to resume.' || echo 'No govdoc-explainer build is running'
